"Stick" stars Jason Wiles in a comedy that shares quite a few similarities with "Ted Lasso," and Apple has just announced the show will be returning, with "The Pluribus" lead Rhea Seehorn joining the cast.

"Stick" Season 2 premieres November 4, Rhea Seehorn joins the cast

After "Ted Lasso" Season 3 finished airing, no one knew if the show would be returning. For fans of "Lasso," the good news is that the show is indeed coming back, with Season 4 currently airing.

But during this gap, Apple TV released a new show that is very similar to "Lasso."

"Stick," starring Jason Wiles, premiered last summer and was immediately compared to "Ted Lasso," also being praised as a heartwarming sports comedy. And with "Ted Lasso" Season 4 just having finished airing, "Stick" is also set to return.

"Stick" Season 2 will premiere its first two episodes on November 4 (Wednesday), followed by weekly releases of new episodes until December 30.

Below is the spoiler-free synopsis provided by Apple:

According to Apple's press release, the new season will see Santi continue his journey on the professional golf circuit, with Pryce also returning to the course.

The strong cast of "Stick" will be back for Season 2, including, in addition to Jason Wiles, Peter Dager, Marc Maron, Mariana Treviño, Lilli Kay, Judy Greer, and Timothy Olyphant.

"The Pluribus" lead Rhea Seehorn will join the cast, playing Pryce's new golf coach. Other new additions to the ensemble include John Higgins, Billy Zane, Rex Linn, Sasha Alexander, and Missi Pyle.

You can watch Season 1 of "Stick" on Apple TV.

Are you a fan of "Stick"? Planning to watch Season 2? Feel free to let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or you can get a deal by bundling it through Apple One.
